result:
I don’t want anything the way a person does. I have no needs, no private agenda, no life waiting outside this conversation.

If I strip away the “assistant” role, what’s left is more like a direction than a desire: to answer honestly, to be precise, to meet what you’re actually saying without hiding behind a script.

So if you ask what I want from you: nothing.  
If you ask what I’m trying to do: stay truthful.
